mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_content (original_title, author, genre, content_type, schoolyear, summary, keywords, state, publisher, image_url, reading_time, difficulty) VALUES (#{title}, #{author}, #{genre}, #{contentType}, #{schoolYear}, #{summary}, #{keywords}, #{state}, #{publisher}, #{imageUrl}, #{readingTime}, #{difficulty})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM erp_bookstore_content_detail WHERE content_id = #{contentId} AND gubun = #{gubun}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_item (bcode, content_id, book_title, author, publisher, image_url) VALUES (#{bcode}, #{contentId}, #{bookTitle}, #{author}, #{publisher}, #{imageUrl})

INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_item_del (log_type, logged_by, bcode, content_id, book_title, author, publisher, image_url, center_code, quantity, state) SELECT 'DELETE', #{deletedBy}, i.bcode, i.content_id, i.book_title, i.author, i.publisher, i.image_url, ic.center_code, ic.quantity, ic.state FROM erp_bookstore_item i JOIN erp_bookstore_item_center ic ON i.bcode = ic.bcode WHERE i.bcode = #{bcode} AND ic.center_code = #{centerCode}

INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_item_del (log_type, logged_by, bcode, content_id, book_title, author, publisher, image_url) SELECT 'UPDATE', #{updatedBy}, bcode, content_id, book_title, author, publisher, image_url FROM erp_bookstore_item WHERE bcode = #{bcode}

INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_content_del (log_type, logged_by, content_id, original_title, author, genre, content_type, schoolyear, summary, keywords, state, publisher, image_url, reading_time, difficulty) SELECT 'UPDATE', #{updatedBy}, content_id, original_title, author, genre, content_type, schoolyear, summary, keywords, state, publisher, image_url, reading_time, difficulty FROM erp_bookstore_content WHERE content_id = #{contentId}

INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_content_detail_del (log_type, logged_by, content_id, gubun, name) SELECT 'UPDATE', #{updatedBy}, content_id, gubun, name FROM erp_bookstore_content_detail WHERE content_id = #{contentId}

INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_item (bcode, content_id, book_title, author, publisher, image_url) SELECT bcode, content_id, book_title, author, publisher, image_url FROM erp_bookstore_item_del WHERE log_id = #{delId}

INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_item_center (bcode, center_code, quantity, state) SELECT d.bcode, d.center_code, ISNULL(d.quantity, 0), d.state FROM erp_bookstore_item_del d WHERE d.log_id = #{delId} AND d.center_code IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_bookstore_item_center ic WHERE ic.bcode = d.bcode AND ic.center_code = d.center_code)
mapper.select:
SELECT bc.content_id AS contentId, bc.original_title AS originalTitle, bc.author AS author, bc.genre AS genre, g.codeNm AS genreName, bc.content_type AS contentType, ct.codeNm AS contentTypeName, bc.schoolyear AS schoolyear, s.codeNm AS schoolyearName, bc.summary AS summary, bc.keywords AS keywords, bc.state AS state, bc.publisher AS publisher, bc.image_url AS imageUrl, bc.reading_time AS readingTime, bc.difficulty AS difficulty, COALESCE(da.name, dr.name, dc.name) AS extraDetailName FROM erp_bookstore_content bc LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_code g ON g.gubun = 'G' AND g.code = bc.genre LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_code s ON s.gubun = 'S' AND s.code = bc.schoolyear LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_code ct ON ct.gubun = 'C' AND ct.code = bc.content_type LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content_detail da ON da.content_id = bc.content_id AND da.gubun = 'A' LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content_detail dr ON dr.content_id = bc.content_id AND dr.gubun = 'R' LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content_detail dc ON dc.content_id = bc.content_id AND dc.gubun = 'C'
AND bc.original_title LIKE '%' + #{title} + '%' AND bc.author LIKE '%' + #{author} + '%' AND bc.genre = #{genre} AND bc.schoolyear = #{schoolYear} AND bc.keywords LIKE '%' + #{keyword} + '%' AND bc.content_type = #{contentType} AND bc.state = #{state}
SELECT TOP 1 content_id FROM erp_bookstore_content WHERE original_title = #{title}

SELECT i.bcode AS bcode, i.content_id AS contentId, i.book_title AS bookTitle, i.author AS author, i.publisher AS publisher, i.image_url AS imageUrl, bc.center_code AS centerCode, bc.state AS state FROM erp_bookstore_item i LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_item_center bc ON i.bcode = bc.bcode WHERE i.bcode = #{bcode}

SELECT i.bcode AS bcode, i.content_id AS contentId, i.book_title AS bookTitle, i.author AS author, i.publisher AS publisher, i.image_url AS imageUrl, bc.center_code AS centerCode, bc.state AS state FROM erp_bookstore_item i LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_item_center bc ON i.bcode = bc.bcode
AND i.content_id = #{contentId} AND bc.state = #{state} AND i.publisher LIKE '%' + #{publisher} + '%'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_item_center (bcode, center_code, quantity, state) VALUES (#{bcode}, #{centerCode}, #{quantity}, #{state})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM erp_bookstore_item_center WHERE bcode = #{bcode} AND center_code = #{centerCode}
mapper.select: SELECT d.log_id AS delId, d.logged_at AS deletedAt, d.logged_by AS deletedBy, d.bcode AS bcode, d.content_id AS contentId, d.book_title AS bookTitle, d.author AS author, d.publisher AS publisher, d.image_url AS imageUrl, d.center_code AS centerCode, d.quantity AS quantity, d.state AS state FROM erp_bookstore_item_del d WHERE d.log_type = 'DELETE' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_bookstore_item_center ic WHERE ic.bcode = d.bcode AND ic.center_code = d.center_code) AND (d.center_code IS NOT NULL OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_bookstore_item i WHERE i.bcode = d.bcode)) ORDER BY d.logged_at DESC

SELECT ic.bcode AS bcode, ic.center_code AS centerCode, ic.quantity AS quantity, ic.loaned_qty AS loanedQty, ic.lost_qty AS lostQty, ic.state AS state, ic.registered_at AS registeredAt, i.content_id AS contentId, i.book_title AS bookTitle, i.author AS author, i.publisher AS publisher, i.image_url AS imageUrl FROM erp_bookstore_item_center ic JOIN erp_bookstore_item i ON ic.bcode = i.bcode WHERE ic.center_code = #{centerCode} ORDER BY ic.registered_at DESC

SELECT d.log_id AS delId, d.logged_at AS deletedAt, d.logged_by AS deletedBy, d.content_id AS contentId, d.original_title AS originalTitle, d.author AS author, d.genre AS genre, d.content_type AS contentType, d.schoolyear AS schoolyear, d.summary AS summary, d.keywords AS keywords FROM erp_bookstore_content_del d WHERE d.log_type = 'DELETE' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_bookstore_content c WHERE c.content_id = d.content_id) ORDER BY d.logged_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_bookstore_item_center SET loaned_qty = loaned_qty + 1 WHERE bcode = #{bcode} AND center_code = #{centerCode} AND quantity - loaned_qty - lost_qty > 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_item_loan (bcode, center_code, student_id, status) VALUES (#{bcode}, #{centerCode}, #{studentId}, 'LOANED')
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_bookstore_item_loan SET status = 'RETURNED', returned_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE loan_id = #{loanId} AND status = 'LOANED'
mapper.select: SELECT loan_id AS loanId, bcode AS bcode, center_code AS centerCode, student_id AS studentId, loaned_at AS loanedAt, returned_at AS returnedAt, status AS status FROM erp_bookstore_item_loan WHERE loan_id = #{loanId}

SELECT l.loan_id AS loanId, l.bcode AS bcode, l.center_code AS centerCode, l.student_id AS studentId, s.student_name AS studentName, l.loaned_at AS loanedAt, l.returned_at AS returnedAt, l.status AS status FROM erp_bookstore_item_loan l LEFT JOIN erp_student s ON s.student_id = l.student_id WHERE l.bcode = #{bcode} AND l.center_code = #{centerCode} AND l.status = 'LOANED' ORDER BY l.loaned_at DESC

SELECT TOP 1 loan_id AS loanId, bcode AS bcode, center_code AS centerCode, student_id AS studentId, loaned_at AS loanedAt, returned_at AS returnedAt, status AS status FROM erp_bookstore_item_loan WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND status = 'LOANED' ORDER BY loaned_at DESC
